deep_dive.title: Cinematize from Unreal: Agentic Choreography for Controllable World Simulation
deep_dive.abstract: Controllable world simulation requires more than visually plausible frames: scenes must retain persistent state, coordinated actions, and editable temporal structure. Generative world models offer flexible visual synthesis, but their outputs do not always expose the objects and transitions needed for precise revision. Graphics engines provide executable state and direct control, yet translating language into valid operations requires specialized knowledge of assets, geometry, and interdependent APIs. We present CineU (Cinematize from Unreal), an agentic system for language-driven world orchestration and cinematic choreography within Unreal Engine. From a code-based world modeling perspective, an Unreal project serves as a persistent, inspectable world representation, while agent-generated code specifies operations whose effects can be executed and verified. CineU combines hierarchical orchestration, cascaded asset retrieval and geometry-constrained placement, capability-aligned code synthesis, and multi-stage verification with localized repair. Shared scene and timeline context coordinates entities, actions, camera trajectories, and shot boundaries while supporting dependency-aware revisions. Experiments on scene construction, selective editing, multi-shot cinematography, and component ablations show how specialized execution knowledge and engine feedback improve task completion and targeted recovery. CineU illustrates how executable world state can complement learned visual generation to support controllable and revisable simulated worlds.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: CineU is an agentic system that translates language into valid Unreal Engine operations to orchestrate cinematic, controllable world simulation with persistent, inspectable state and editable temporal structure.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对生成式世界模型难以暴露可精确修改的对象与状态转移、而图形引擎又需要专业资产与几何知识的问题，本文提出CineU智能体系统，将自然语言翻译为虚幻引擎中合法的操作序列，实现电影化的世界编排与可控仿真。系统把虚幻工程视为持久、可检查的代码化世界模型，支持协调动作与可编辑的时间结构。该工作为语言驱动的可控世界构建提供了可执行、可复现的编排范式。
